Application Data.NAME: Sweet Spot Bakery
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sweet Spot Bakery is a retail bakery specializing in artisanal breads, pastries, and bagels, with a focus on high-quality ingredients sourced from certified suppliers. We provide on-site sales with limited seating for customers, ensuring a comfortable café atmosphere. Our operations include an online ordering platform for pre-orders, enhancing customer convenience. We maintain strict food safety protocols, with staff certified in ServSafe, and adhere to rigorous sanitation and refrigeration standards. Our facility is equipped with a UL-rated automatic extinguishing system over all cooking equipment and a monitored fire and burglar alarm system. Additionally, we offer a selection of coffee beverages, including limited options for alcohol service, supported by appropriate liquor liability coverage and staff training. Our commitment to quality and safety ensures that we deliver delicious baked goods while mitigating risks associated with food safety and property exposure.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On June 12, 2023, a power outage caused a refrigeration failure, resulting in the spoilage of perishable inventory valued at $2,000. The loss was reported immediately, and all affected products were discarded following food safety guidelines. The claim was settled promptly by the insurance provider, and there are no outstanding issues regarding this loss.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL Class 350, Grade B, Label A
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored security system with nightly patrols, perimeter fencing, and employee training on theft prevention.
